title: Shopping list
goal: Build a shopping list web app. The page has a text input with the placeholder "Item", a button labelled "Add", and the list of stored items. Items are stored on the server, each with a name. Each item in the list has a button labelled "Remove NAME", where NAME is the item name. Clicking Add stores the item and shows it. Clicking a Remove button deletes that item from the server and from the list. Stored items are shown when the page loads. Items are kept when the server restarts.
